nonBlockingIssues.description: The Linux uninstall script removes `~/.local/share/neozed/neozed-$db_suffix.sock`, but the CLI/runtime create per-channel sockets named `zed-<channel>.sock`, so uninstall leaves the stale IPC socket behind.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Fix the custom droid model configuration used by scrutiny review subagents, or document a manual-review fallback when Task-based reviewers cannot launch.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Both Task invocations for `scrutiny-feature-reviewer` and fallback `worker` reviewers failed immediately with `Invalid model: custom:droidproxy:gpt-5.4`, so feature reviews had to be performed manually in this validator session.
